style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial hardware e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of near-black studio field #141416, brushed cool silver-grey panels #B7BAC0, clean information panels #FFFFFF, and one deep tool-green accent #1F7A55 reserved for keylines, badges and the single CTA button; cool neutral tone, never warm; one modern geometric sans-serif family for all Chinese and Latin text; thin single-weight line glyphs and hairline dashed rules only; polished steel rendered under a hard raking side key with a soft #FFFFFF bounce fill so one continuous specular streak runs along each body, with a consistent soft contact shadow grounding every part; flat information-card layout with left photo and right #C9CCD1 gradient panel, hexagonal nut-shaped masked windows, chrome coin medallion badges, #FFFFFF pill labels; product always shown full length with its jaw and adjustment wheel intact at identical scale and identical hero angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm lifestyle cast, no added logo or watermark.
style.presentationRules: product shown full length with jaw and adjustment wheel intact, identical scale and identical hero angle across shots, hexagonal nut-shaped masked windows, left photo / right #C9CCD1 gradient detail cards, #1F7A55 accent reserved for keylines, badges and the single CTA button
style.surfaceSystem: glossy #0B0B0D plate and pedestal, matte #1C1C1E near-black worktop, brushed #B7BAC0 steel panel, #8A8579 concrete utility corner; never wood, never fabric
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all Chinese and Latin text; #C9CCD1 metallic-gradient display headline, #FFFFFF pill badge, #2D2D2D labels; every rendered string is a short placeholder, no dense body copy
